items.description: Undo/redo history for a single wireframe editor instance. Not a DI service. TmWireframeEditor creates one instance and cascades it to child components via CascadingValue. Each editor on the page gets its own isolated stack.

members.name: NextRedoName
members.description: Name of the next command that would be redone, or null.

members.name: NextUndoName
members.description: Name of the next command that would be undone, or null.

members.name: Clear
members.description: Clears both stacks (e.g. after loading a new document).

members.name: Push
members.description: Executes and pushes it onto the undo stack. Clears the redo stack. Move coalescing: if the previous command is a targeting the same element ids and was pushed within 100 ms, the new command is merged into it (keeps the original "before" positions, updates "after").

members.name: Redo
members.description: Re-applies the most recently undone command. No-op if stack is empty.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Reverses the most recent command. No-op if stack is empty.

members.name: RenderSvg
members.description: Renders the wireframe SVG shape into . Coordinates inside the render are relative to the element's top-left (0, 0). The outer <g> transform is applied by the canvas.

members.name: SizePresets
members.description: Optional map from a size prop value to canonical element dimensions. When the user changes the size prop and the new value has an entry here, the canvas element is automatically resized to these dimensions. Components where size describes an internal sub-element (e.g. TmModal's dialog inside a full-screen overlay) should leave this null and handle sizing in their render lambda.

items.description: SVG-based wireframe canvas. Renders WireframeDocument elements as scalable SVG shapes and handles pan, zoom, drag-move, resize (8-handle), rubber-band multi-select, element drop from toolbox, keyboard nudge, and context menu. Communicates with wireframe-designer.js for all mouse/touch interactions. All mutations go through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Typically used as a child of TmWireframeEditor rather than directly.

items.description: Top-level wireframe editor component. Composes the canvas, toolbox, properties panel, minimap, and toolbar into a fully working editor. Creates and owns a WireframeCommandStack (undo/redo) and exposes it to all child components via CascadingValue. Supports JSON import/export, SVG export, zoom, grid, read-only mode, and collapsible panels. Tool mode (Select/Pan) can be switched via toolbar buttons or keyboard shortcuts V/H. Canvas size is editable from the toolbar.

examples.code:

@code {

        await Http.PutAsJsonAsync("api/wireframes/my-doc", json);
    }
}

examples.title: Minimap bound to canvas viewport
examples.code:
<TmWireframeMinimap Document="_document"
                    SelectedIds="_selectedIds"
                    Viewport="_viewport"
                    Width="180"
                    NavigateRequested="OnMinimapNavigate" />

@code {
    private MinimapViewport? _viewport;

    private async Task OnMinimapNavigate(MinimapNavigateArgs args)
    {
        if (_canvas is not null)
            await _canvas.ScrollTo(args.CentreX, args.CentreY);
    }
}

items.description: Properties panel for the wireframe editor. Shows editable fields for the currently selected element(s). Supports single-select (all PropDef fields grouped by category, plus Layout X/Y/W/H and Element/ZIndex sections) and multi-select (intersection of common props, Mixed indicator when values differ). All mutations are routed through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Text and number inputs use per-field debounce (350 ms); dropdowns and checkboxes apply immediately. Changing a size prop with SizePresets defined automatically resizes the element.
